    // Only the real globals carry the protocol. A shadowing local resolves to a different symbol
    // and keeps whatever it declares.
    
    local Helpers = { describe = function(self: table): string return "d"; end };
    local mt = { __index = Helpers };

    // A never-reassigned alias, renamed or not, is the global like any other builtin's:
    // the call pairs, so describe resolves through __index.
